notes.title: Sailor Gull Enemy Update
notes.notes:
Happy Friday folks!

This past week was dedicated to finishing the Party Fish enemy sprite and adding the Fish-in-a-Barrel and the Sailor Gull enemies to the game!

For the Party Fish I started out with an outline this time
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/ac8e3c2fb93e009eea3a625b6a058d02262b8a68.png[/img]

Then I added the base colors with the water color as background to make sure the fish stood out enough.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/e9d8fab1792397d7c9ea4578b361afc342a6e00b.png[/img]

After that I painted in shadows
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/c26be6d061e157b88dcec89662b45e9d95275d7d.png[/img]

Then colored in the highlights
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/e2d80bc95c530cc19b722e27f9da26223c375a9b.png[/img]

And finally tweaking the finer details
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/f5aeb513ca95215c7975b1462ec06002bae969c1.png[/img]

[b]Fish-in-a-Barrel Enemy [/b]

They will hop from place to place and even roll down slopes to get to Captain Caiman's Birthday Bash!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/0daa334c73548a2661d864826b1e348df14c0a78.gif[/img]

[b]Sailor Gull[/b]

These guys are stuck carrying barrels around when they could be partying. If they hurry then they can make it to the party before its over. Be careful, these fellas are on a mission and will toss barrels at you if  get in the way of their work.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/fe135777aa9233e80bb385b4596660ac58c93bf7.gif[/img]


Thanks for reading and be sure to WISHLIST🌟
See you next week!

notes.title: Sunset Harbor Sketch Dump!
notes.notes:
Happy Friday folks!

This week was spent mostly on building levels and sketching out some enemies. I added a new [b]slide[/b] mechanic and swimming animations! 

I'll open with the [b]slide[/b] mechanic and water animations. 
Sunset Harbor has plenty of water and nooks and crannies. Blokhed can't really swim and hates the water. He's great at sliding though. Lucky for him Jelli can help keep them afloat!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/24e3dd156e160febc5364886d4bf04513a2afc63.gif[/img]

Then there's the sketch dump!

This is the [b]Fried Squid[/b], an enemy that swoops down and shocks!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/3a1c6d62b113a42998b9288c719d8e77b463d14e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/d21690e39cb93db2ca6d29293f34ccc35f7fbb6e.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Fish in a Barrel[/b], an enemy that hops and rolls!
[b]Sailor Gull[/b] who's too busy working to deal with you. Get too close and he'll toss a barrel at ya.
[b]Bedded Clams[/b] that chase you underwater.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/c36911aec0e94205f734db946a32249ddf850312.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/2ca49945fbb7ac9b2ac43696a66ffb389155e2d0.jpg[/img][/url]

Here are a few NPC Ideas:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/907a8eb3002d7bfaf6418b8d42f259a423cc30dc.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/693734e9b18d8851b1d0143faa88649a3275a110.jpg[/img][/url]

Sketch studies of buildings for the background:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/ffd5a1b6876f58b47be955417fb8f096ac7cf8f1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/0bce7a98cad046c6c3dfeba5009f7569deff7cd2.jpg[/img][/url]

And finally, Captain Caiman: The Birthday Boy. He has Froggy performing for his birthday and won't let you ruin it!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/aa273671c71b7ff6dd17991bc5ee7c897d590dc4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/046a4b410bb172a00c1b5793abfdf02732324e15.jpg[/img][/url]

Thanks for reading and be sure to WISHLIST🌟 
See you next week!

notes.title: Version Update 0.2.7
notes.notes:
Happy Friday folks!

I've made some bug fixes this week, added more hazards, and updated the FlowerHopper boss!

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]     contact with Jelli no longer freezes the game
[*]     the player no longer moves during the pause menu
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*]     the hunny bun cost for level 2 has been dropped to 6 from 15
[*]     the FlowerHopper's Rival Form has been added ( more on that below )
[*]     added sounds to menu selections
[/list]


The first hazard I added is for the Sunset Harbor world; the Wooden Smasher!

I started with a basic shape

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/1d45d517384c43f7be4ab8e0a06fd465a0b159f8.png[/img]

Then I outlined it in a dark brown and broke up some detailed shapes like the pole and center nob thingy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/3b1c88ebd6f8b2f965d0d90b74b04139c781be2d.png[/img]

Next, I added some basic details like the grain lines of the wood.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/1bde5b9399e5b421a65834c231c572dfc6960df0.png[/img]

Then I added shadows and highlights to the wood and colored the connecting nut yellow to break up the color.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/3b92f6a0887324a7e0c5e24cc382ff19d2036e8c.png[/img]

I finally finished it with a stone base and a wheel that turns when it goes up and down
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/649605cdca723c8fb475d085a4e0162b518b4ade.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/02ee0e847cdb1a8246b99d0c63a0de7de0ce7f4c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/02ee0e847cdb1a8246b99d0c63a0de7de0ce7f4c.gif[/img][/url]


The next hazard is a Swinging Ball. It just has basic functionality for now and can be quite challenging to get past.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/fb3534035de4234088071fc4e7c5f326d92111c8.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/fb3534035de4234088071fc4e7c5f326d92111c8.gif[/img][/url]

Every boss has what's called a Rival Form. This form is activated when certain objectives are failed.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/b482214a5cc3f855f65cedb27099ac9a4b0f13a5.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/b482214a5cc3f855f65cedb27099ac9a4b0f13a5.gif[/img][/url]

Thanks for reading and be sure to WISHLIST🌟 
See you next week!

notes.title: Saving Progress!
notes.notes:
Happy Thursday folks!


These past two weeks have been filled with fixing bugs and implementing saving and loading your progress!


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]     the pause menu no longer stays on the screen when exited
[*]     movement is paused until the level title loads in
[*]     dialog boxes no longer freeze the player when they disappear
[*]     the world map no longer has movement issues
[/list]


[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]     the mouse is no longer required to rebind keys
[*]     you can now save and load your progress
[/list]

Thanks for reading and be sure to WISHLIST on Steam🌟 See you next week!
Blokhed Jelli

notes.title: We've Got WATER!
notes.notes:
Happy Thursday folks!

This week I added some water to the world!

First I started with the main waves
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/ca7b60feaeaa6531f32bdc5f444305d0d4da3b11.png[/img]

Then I added waves behind the main waves
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/96cde49628742b3ada949992c317a1d19eeb5f28.png[/img]

Finally, I finished it with darker waves at the bottom
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/d1fb583d532df300e8f90660beaec05ff2ce7c25.png[/img]

And voila! A pretty cool water sprite!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/27bbde3c583ed8ac689e4070e9a20e046652fb5f.gif[/img]

I plan to add more details later but I'm happy with how it turned out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/89cde2b05945f4191bdef239576ef38117570f38.gif[/img]

What do you think of water in platformers? Should they be just decoration or have whole levels dedicated to them? Let me know in the comments!

Thanks for reading and be sure to WISHLIST on Steam🌟 
See you next week!

notes.title: Freeze Frames!?
notes.notes:

This week I tackled cleaning up the demo with a few bug fixes and added a freeze frame when you defeat enemies!

The Pops icon hops when you don't have enough hunny buns to enter a level and disappears when you do have enough!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/39912dc471b12dd487558666e4bfca90bd618650.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/39912dc471b12dd487558666e4bfca90bd618650.gif[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/779fb7b26cbeb1a56fef5e24154467e6f76e392c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/779fb7b26cbeb1a56fef5e24154467e6f76e392c.gif[/img][/url]

I also added a congratulations message for collecting all 20 hunny buns in a level.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/01205d3338ffe9a7f40ef4c05b01bcdfa4503408.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/01205d3338ffe9a7f40ef4c05b01bcdfa4503408.gif[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/50a5a23f61f710920ad980035b8762d2b7824fde.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/50a5a23f61f710920ad980035b8762d2b7824fde.gif[/img][/url]

Blokhed Jelli

notes.title: A New Enemy for the Forest World
notes.notes:
Happy Thursday Folks!

This week I started working on the enemies, hazards, and moving platforms for the Forest World( name coming soon).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/b773ed3e95d2479b87661fc03a81e18c4753d767.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/3e558d60f0b9cbcc51714d9a2f3035f018e70d70.gif[/img]

Now I would like to introduce you to the first enemy,  the Tenrecs🦔, spikey guys that carry and plant those odd purple flowers🌷.
I wonder who they're working for?

For this guy, I started with basic shapes

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/420bca0b37d91aa8bb6cec9285e885d574cc9a0e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/3cacbd247c1cdef97c56cefeccf3e3c96c9e1ba9.png[/img][/url]

After adjusting the size a bit I painted the colors and details.
I chose yellow pants to help the silhouette stand out against the green and blues in the background.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/347763a70c804d4a51694daa760e5dbdf4e5463f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/3d1976c65530da3290ee7771dd27aa3b3f77d41c.png[/img][/url]

For the bag, I started with a circle. Then, I shaped it before adding some shade variance.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/82aac24e88a057ee4fe8edb064b9eb6ce0d98c95.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/7a14a0d5e039bc57ea4f22ead40cc347124d54c8.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/3f2c680d1ca128ac767b2c82d2a3d6458263f128.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/08783cc5f6ed8f65de19bd8ae756b50203eead63.png[/img][/url]

Once I was happy with the shape and shading I gave it a better color and added an outline.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/e2a7ca3edd57ccaf79e4521e583c27700c5eeaf8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/788f3a75c1d99c6a2f4a0fcf12cc6f48b9ea4f3c.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/df6f408416d8caf6dee632d98dfd3cbb41665dfe.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/910ef3854a97019d945d071e42639db95bc089e3.png[/img][/url]

Now to add the mysterious flowers starting with basic shapes.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/f7758a8404856dc5b87c85a6e47ece0b84b31fbb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/58777152892146fac1ca9f6d265a9b533322c24a.png[/img][/url]


Then shading and highlights.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/0e98b6079324d4050883e44337b3efe0f6eb4c32.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/26e5d6fa71e86c080acd9a9c99c4cb2a4910dc21.png[/img][/url]


What are your impressions of the Tenrecs? Let me know in the comment section below!

Thanks for reading and don't forget to leave a follow to stay current on updates and announcements🌟 See you next week!
